description: This file contains the NotesViewModel class, which manages notes data, interactions with the repository, and business logic for a note-taking application using Android architecture components and Jetpack Compose.

classes.name: NotesViewModel
classes.description: Android ViewModel for handling note data and business logic, including CRUD operations, filtering, and state management.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads all notes from the repository and sorts them by most recent update.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with specified title, content, and tags, then reloads the notes.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note and reloads the notes.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID and then reloads the notes.

methods.name: getFilteredNotes
methods.description: Returns notes filtered by selected tag and search query.

methods.name: getAllTags
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of all unique tags from current notes.

methods.name: loadNotesOnMain
methods.description: Reloads notes on the main (UI) thread to update state.
